verdicts.root_cause_if_confirmed: REST v2 API layer missing load state validation before proxy.Search() call
verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/search endpoint violates explicit contract constraint milvus_state_entities_search_001 ('collection is loaded'). Source code confirms handler_v2.go:1487 search() function does NOT validate collection load state before calling proxy.Search(), unlike gRPC layer which correctly returns 'collection not loaded' error. Live container reproduction shows REST v2 returns HTTP 200 with results on unloaded collection, while pymilvus SDK (gRPC) correctly rejects same request with error code 101. This is a genuine API inconsistency defect in REST v2 layer.
